state.label: Pipe distance X
state.description: Horizontal distance to the trailing edge of the closest pipe ahead. Clipped to 0 once the bird passes it.

state.label: Gap offset Y
state.description: Vertical offset between the bird and the center of the current gap. Positive means the bird is below the gap.

state.label: Vertical velocity
state.description: Current vertical velocity of the bird. Gravity is 1000 px/s² and a flap sets it to −350.

state.label: Gap height
state.description: Opening height of the current pipe pair. Gaps spawn randomly between 200 and 410 px.

state.label: Next pipe distance X
state.description: Distance to the pipe pair after the current one, so the agent can plan two obstacles ahead.

state.label: Next gap offset Y
state.description: Vertical offset to the center of the next gap.

state.label: Next gap height
state.description: Opening height of the next pipe pair.

state.label: Pipe speed
state.description: Current scroll speed of the world. Speed grows with the score (200 + 0.4 × score, capped at 400), so the environment gets faster as the agent succeeds.

actions.name: IDLE
actions.description: Let physics run. Gravity pulls the bird down and it begins to tilt forward.

actions.name: FLAP
actions.description: Set vertical velocity to −350 px/s. Ignored while the bird is already rising fast (velocity.y ≤ −180), which prevents climb-spam.

exploreBias.description: During exploration the agent does not pick uniformly: a random action flaps only 5% of the time. Random flapping is almost always fatal, so biased exploration produces survivable random trajectories.

rewards.note: Small constant incentive for staying alive.
Gaussian proximity reward centered on the gap (σ = 0.5), shifted down by 0.35.
The same shaping term turns negative away from the gap center (clamped at −1.0).
One-time bonus each time the bird clears a pipe pair.
Terminal transition stored with a zeroed next state.

network.outputMeaning: One Q-value per action: Q(s, IDLE) and Q(s, FLAP).

memory.sampler: Uniform random over the 50k legacy buffer
memory.discardRule: Frames with no pipe on screen (dx ≥ 1) are never stored.
memory.alternatives: The buffer also implements reservoir, recency, crash-focus, and reward-prioritized samplers, kept in the codebase for experimentation.

persistence.saved: Network weights, replay buffers, epsilon, generation
persistence.trigger: Saved on every death and restored on load — training continues across sessions.
